name: RN (Rusty Nail) Design
old_description: While RN Design specializes in bunk rooms, we’ve also done quite a few custom bars throughout the years. We bring handcrafted and high-end luxury to your home or business so you can focus on entertaining your guests. From live-edge, warm walnut slabs to refined and sleek oak bars - even vintage truck bars with custom lighting, we can make your vision come to life.
about:
RN Design operates from Bozeman, Montana, where it has built a reputation for handcrafted bunk rooms and custom bars. The firm is led by designer Jason, who heads a team that creates one-of-a-kind interior installations for homes and businesses.

The company designs and fabricates custom bunk rooms, bunk beds, furniture, and themed interiors, with a particular focus on bars made from live-edge walnut slabs, sleek oak, and vintage truck components fitted with custom lighting. Projects range from residential sleeping spaces to commercial hospitality installations, all produced in their workshop using woodworking and metalworking processes.

Clients include construction firms such as Zoske Construction, as well as individual homeowners and business owners seeking unique entertaining spaces. The firm serves both residential and commercial sectors, delivering tailored pieces that integrate into larger building projects or stand alone as focal points.

RN Design emphasizes handcrafted, high-end luxury and the ability to translate a client's vision into a finished piece, promoting designs that are "uniquely you" rather than following catalog templates.
